qualitative.source: claude-code (viewed contact sheet 1 of 4 + computed metrics)
qualitative.summary: A diary-style 'pov' vlog where the creator's voice carries almost the entire runtime (98% speech coverage). A 20-second teaser of upcoming moments is followed by a bold yellow location title, then a long static sit-down to camera in a garden (~0:30-4:18). The rest is wide-angle selfie footage (low angles, ceiling lights), friends hanging out at home, and phone-in-hand updates. Captions are burned in. The tone is warm, natural light, slightly lifted blacks.
qualitative.hook_analysis: Spoken cold open plus a visual teaser: brief glimpses (walking in a rainforest, a 'MELBOURNE' title card, cooking) followed immediately by direct-address talk; the hook is the creator's personality and stated premise rather than spectacle.
qualitative.narrative_arc: Chronological diary: reflection/sit-down -> daily life with friends -> travel to the next city ('we'll be flying to Melbourne tomorrow'). Progression is marked by stated plans, not chapters.
qualitative.camera_and_composition: Locked-off medium sit-down; ultra-wide handheld selfie (GoPro/Osmo-style) at low angles; candid over-the-shoulder group moments. Composition is casual and functional.
qualitative.color_and_grade: Warm, natural daylight greens; interiors are dim and moody with practical lights; mild contrast.
qualitative.sound_and_music: Dense talk (~175 wpm); music is mostly a bed under speech rather than standalone montage (only ~1% of runtime has no speech).
what_to_borrow: A 10-20 second teaser of later moments before the talk starts
Bold typographic location cards to mark arrivals
Burned-in captions for talk-heavy personal sections
Unpolished wide-angle selfie for authenticity in transitional moments
what_to_avoid_copying: Four-minute static talking-head blocks - for a travel film keep reflections short and cover them with b-roll

Shot types use face/sky/edge heuristics on low-resolution frames - treat as approximate.
